title: Statistics
userActivityTabTooltip:
User activity

How long you are active in front of Heidrun.

  • One bar for each slot of time, with one color for each workspace.
  • Choose the time range, the slot length, and the workspaces.
rangeHourTitle: Show the user activity time of the last hour
rangeDayTitle: Show the user activity time of the last day
rangeWeekTitle: Show the user activity time of the last week
slotTitle: Cut the time range into slots of {slotLength}
workspacesAllTitle: Show the user activity time of every workspace, or of none
workspaceTitle: Show or hide the user activity time of the workspace in the folder {folder}
workspacesNone: No workspace is chosen. Choose a workspace to see its user activity time.
loadError: The user activity cannot be read: {error}
hourChartLabel: Histogram of the user activity time of the last hour, in slots of {slotLength}
dayChartLabel: Histogram of the user activity time of the last day, in slots of {slotLength}
weekChartLabel: Histogram of the user activity time of the last week, in slots of {slotLength}
hourChartTitle: User activity time of the last hour
dayChartTitle: User activity time of the last day
weekChartTitle: User activity time of the last week
personWorkTabTooltip:
Work of one person

How much one person does, with one bar for each day.

  • Git history: the commits and the pull requests of the person, and the number of issues.
  • AI cost: the estimated cost of the chats of the coding agents.
personWorkSevenDaysTitle: Show the work of the person over the last 7 days, with one bar for each day
personWorkThirtyDaysTitle: Show the work of the person over the last 30 days, with one bar for each day
